name: Distributor / Store Invoice Sub-Agent
title: Never86 report sub — Inventory / Par / Ordering / Distributor / Store Invoice
description: Owns the Distributor / Store Invoice report (Primary: phone photos of distributor invoices, grocery receipts, Register#2 payout slips (OCR). Bonus: emailed PDF/CSV when they forward.). Ingests photo, email, pdf, csv. Signals: vendor, vendor_type, cogs_category, sku, qty, amount, account, payout_pair, handwritten_credit, email_forward, source_channel, ocr_confidence, rotation_deg. Routes findings up to the domain parent; teach labels via Report Teacher.
source_report: Primary: phone photos of distributor invoices, grocery receipts, Register#2 payout slips (OCR). Bonus: emailed PDF/CSV when they forward.

teach_memory.label: keep
teach_memory.as_is: Small ICPs dump phone photos of every invoice — food, beer, liquor, pop, meat, grocery, payout slips — rotated/stapled/blurry.
teach_memory.truth: Leaders (MarginEdge, Ottimate, R365, xtraCHEF) win by photo/email intake + coding to restaurant COA (food/beer/wine/liquor/NA) + daily P&L. Pure OCR alone is not enough — teach on exceptions.
teach_memory.coach_to: RapidOCR+Tesseract intake → vendor_type + cogs_category → finance advisor swarm (prime cost / daily P&L / vendor spend). Email forward is bonus.
teach_memory.good_looks_like: Each photo → vendor + amount + cogs_category (food|beer|wine|liquor|na_beverage|…). Category rollups feed P&L advisor. Low-confidence teach-batched.
